about.title: Your Vision, Our Priority
about.description: At Ananta Nethralaya, we bring together advanced technology, surgical precision, and compassionate care to deliver world-class eye treatment in a comforting environment.
about.shortDescription: Led by Dr. Ashwin C. Somarajan, an experienced vitreoretinal and Cataract surgeon with over 8 years of expertise in ophthalmology, our mission is to make quality eye care accessible and trustworthy for every patient.
about.tagline: From routine consultations to advanced cataract and retina surgeries, we are dedicated to preserving and restoring sight — because every vision deserves clarity.
